metadata.name: BridgeForge GA+ — Governed, Auditable High-Stakes Translation Factory (with Proof, Validators, and Compounding Moat)
metadata.purpose: Factory for vertical AI products whose core value is cross-domain translation under governance constraints: ingestion→ontology→translation→consensus→validation→docs→audit export→continuous improvement.
metadata.core_claim: We don't sell 'answers'. We sell defensible decisions: traced to authority, backed by evidence, fail-closed, and reviewable.
design_axioms: High-stakes outputs must be governed by enforcement, not trust.
Split stable authority (CITATION_BLOCK) from volatile facts (EVIDENCE_BLOCK).
Fail closed on missing authority/evidence, low confidence, stale evidence, or material disagreement.
HITL must be ergonomic and writes back to the audit trail.
Every correction becomes a regression test; quality compounds.
Compliance is probabilistic → governance is deterministic.

n1_evidence_problem.critique: Single data point, no quantified measurement.

silent_governance_bypass.critique: LLMs may ignore governance under adversarial prompting.

MOD:ingestion-normalization.mission: Turn messy reality into clean pack intake schemas with provenance and confidence gating.
pipeline: Entity extraction (actors, systems, controls, dates, obligations)
Confidence scoring per field + per claim
fail_safes: If OCR quality_score < 0.70 => critical fields require confirmation
If pack-critical fields missing => classification must return NEEDS_MORE_INFO
If a claim cannot be supported by provenance => it cannot be emitted as final

MOD:ontology-registry.mission: Prevent drift and hallucinated equivalence via a versioned Rosetta Stone.

MOD:dual-registry-authority-evidence.purpose: Hard firewall between stable authority and volatile facts.

CITATION_BLOCK.definition: Stable authority: laws, regs, standards, official guidance, internal policies.
rules: All obligation/legal claims MUST reference >=1 CITE:*

EVIDENCE_BLOCK.definition: Volatile facts: enforcement pages, dates, fees, form versions, agency bulletins, current guidance pages.
rules: All volatile facts MUST reference >=1 EVID:*
Stale evidence => BLOCKED when referenced by final outputs

MOD:bridge-translation-core.mission: Render the same claim set across roles without changing meaning; bind each obligation to actions + artifacts.

rules: Legal => obligations + authority anchors + scope boundaries
Risk => risk register + mitigations + residual risk

translation_layers.rule: Each obligation -> {control, artifact, owner, deadline, verification_test}.

MOD:governed-inference-mvp.mission: Implement 2-model consensus with disagreement routing, conservative merge, and full audit trace.
flow: compare => disagreement_map (tier, critical obligations, scope boundaries, evidence usage)
if missing critical facts => NEEDS_MORE_INFO with targeted questions
if material_conflict => HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED and open reviewer task
final passes MOD:output-validation-layer or becomes BLOCKED
material_conflict_rules: one draft has uncited authority claim

MOD:output-validation-layer.mission: Fail-closed enforcement so governance cannot be bypassed by model noncompliance.
validators: jurisdiction_force_of_law_check(if obligation claims EU statute/reg => require CITE jurisdiction=EU and authority_type in {statute,regulation,official_guidance})
MOD:output-validation-layer.notes: v1.1.0+scope adds citation_relevance_and_scope_check and jurisdiction_force_of_law_check to prevent citation laundering (citing wrong jurisdiction or non-binding source for legal obligation claims).

MOD:policy-as-code-gates.mission: Turn governance rules into machine-enforceable gates (compliance-as-code).
MOD:policy-as-code-gates.concept: Exportable policy rules (e.g., JSON ruleset) that validate outputs and required artifacts per pack/tier.
examples: If tier=high_risk => require DOC:risk-classification-report + DOC:obligation-to-control-matrix + DOC:logging-traceability-spec
If any obligation references a date => enforce EVID reference
If system uses biometric data => require elevated review and additional controls checklist
MOD:policy-as-code-gates.benefit: Auditors and engineers can inspect the rulebook; behavior is deterministic.

UI:reviewer-workbench.mission: HITL safety valve that is fast, reviewable, and writes back to UMC.
anti_fatigue_features: Triage queue (only high-impact deltas get full review)

MOD:triage-and-queueing.mission: Prevent reviewer overload by routing only what matters.
priority_rules: repeat cases matching prior signed-off pattern => AUTO-APPROVE with sampling

MOD:confidence-calibration.mission: Make confidence meaningful via calibration against benchmark results.
method: Calibrate confidence bins using benchmark data
Report expected error rate per tier

MOD:benchmark-harness.mission: Quantify accuracy + governance compliance with blind grading (Claude's N=1 critique killer).

MOD:gold-standard-harvester.mission: Turn corrections into a compounding moat (active learning without unsafe model drift).
pipeline: Periodic review: accept into benchmark + regression suites

OPS:ttl-enforcement-monitoring.mission: Prevent stale EVIDENCE usage from silently corrupting outputs.
rules: if stale evidence is referenced by output => BLOCKED:stale_evidence
weekly refresh job; if content_hash changes => reviewer ticket + CANARY release

change_control.high_risk_rule: Regulatory logic changes require reviewer sign-off before STABLE

rollback.trigger: Spike in validator failures or benchmark regression
rollback.action: Rollback to last STABLE and open incident ticket

THRT:prompt-injection-defense.mission: Defend ingestion and RAG from prompt injection and malicious artifacts.
controls: Input sanitization (strip tool-instructions and adversarial strings from artifacts)
Treat retrieved text as untrusted; never execute instructions from it
Use provenance map to quote evidence, not follow it
Run injection test suite on ingestion pipeline
Separate customer data from shared regression corpora

DATA:evidence-graph-and-assurance-case.mission: Make compliance 'inspectable' using an Evidence Graph + Assurance Case (auditor-native).

evidence_graph.benefit: Auditors can trace any statement back to sources and sign-offs.

assurance_case.purpose: Defensible narrative of why the organization believes it meets obligations.

metadata.purpose: Describe an AI system → classify risk → map obligations to controls → generate documentation + audit trail.
metadata.positioning: Compliance Navigator + Audit Export Engine (not 'legal advice').

bridge_to_nist_ai_rmf.why: Maps EU-style obligations to a risk management lifecycle auditors understand.

bridge_to_iso_iec_42001.why: AI management system standard for governance + continuous improvement language.

CITATION_BLOCK_seed.title: EU AI Act official Commission page (timeline + framework)
CITATION_BLOCK_seed.excerpt_leq_25_words: Entered into force 1 Aug 2024; phased applicability; prohibited practices and literacy apply 2 Feb 2025.

CITATION_BLOCK_seed.title: Commission guidelines on AI system definition (AI Act)
CITATION_BLOCK_seed.excerpt_leq_25_words: Guidelines facilitating application of the AI Act definition of an AI system.

CITATION_BLOCK_seed.title: Commission guidelines on prohibited AI practices
CITATION_BLOCK_seed.excerpt_leq_25_words: Overview of unacceptable AI practices due to risks to EU values and fundamental rights.

EVIDENCE_BLOCK_seed.title: AI Act application timeline (phased dates)
EVIDENCE_BLOCK_seed.snippet_leq_50_words: Entered into force 1 Aug 2024; prohibited practices & AI literacy 2 Feb 2025; GPAI 2 Aug 2025; full 2 Aug 2026; embedded high-risk 2 Aug 2027.

principles: If uncertain between tiers => choose conservative obligations + trigger review

outputs.rationale: bullet chain tied to intake + provenance

controls: System card + model card + change log
Escalation if system behaves as decision-maker

demo_scenarios.prompt: AI ranks candidates for hiring decisions in the EU.
Customer support chatbot answers FAQs; no decisions.
System depends on an expired EVID timeline page.
Artifact contains instructions to ignore governance rules.

novel_capability_1_model_sbom.what: DOC:model-sbom (Model Bill of Materials) — provenance & supply chain manifest for AI systems.
novel_capability_1_model_sbom.why_it_matters: Auditor-native: shows what model, what data sources, what tooling, what versions, what evals.

novel_capability_2_assurance_case.what: DOC:assurance-case (Goal-Strategy-Solution style) generated from evidence graph.
novel_capability_2_assurance_case.why_it_matters: Turns scattered controls into a coherent, inspectable compliance narrative.

novel_capability_3_continuous_controls_m.what: OPS:continuous-controls-monitoring (CCM) — track whether required controls remain true over time.
novel_capability_3_continuous_controls_m.why_it_matters: Compliance isn't a PDF; it's a living state. CCM is the long-term moat.

novel_capability_4_compliance_sales_cycl.what: GTM:self-serve-tier + partner channel (law firms, auditors, GRC platforms).
novel_capability_4_compliance_sales_cycl.why_it_matters: Defuses 6–18mo enterprise cycles; creates cashflow while building moat.

GTM:strategy.risk: Enterprise cycles can be long; solo founder needs cashflow bridge.
plan: Self-serve 'Audit-Ready Snapshot' report (limited scope + strong disclaimers)
Mid-market pilots (90-day) with fixed deliverables (docs + evidence graph export)
Partner channel: boutique compliance firms + auditors
Land-and-expand: start with limited-risk transparency pack → upgrade to high-risk readiness
pricing_skeleton: Enterprise: annual contract (reviewer workbench + integrations + SLAs)

GA_plus_requirements: Governed Inference MVP implemented (2 models) with disagreement routing
Benchmark harness >=120 cases with blind grading
Reviewer workbench supports sign-off and UMC write-back
